node.statement: Validated node 1.4.1 factors p(t)=(t-r_-)(t-r_+) with r_-<1/8 and r_+>=1-(K_sq+4C_prod)e. Since a_1>=0 and the preceding child proves p(a_1)>=0, positivity of the leading coefficient gives a_1<=r_- or a_1>=r_+. The root hypothesis a_1>=1/4 excludes a_1<=r_- because r_-<1/8<1/4. Therefore a_1>=r_+>=1-(K_sq+4C_prod)e=1-C_diag e.
